originalSourceText:
Q.6   For the planar 2-DOF articulated manipulator  (𝑙1 = 5,  𝑙2 = 4), which statement
       correctly describes its reachable workspace?

      (A) Circular region with radius 9

      (B) Rectangular region bounded by ±9 units

      (C) Annular region satisfying 1 ≤𝑅≤9

      (D) Cylindrical workspace

       Explanation: (C) Refer Slide 29 of Lecture Manipulator Mechanism Design-I

      Combining the forward kinematics with the link lengths gives a maximum reach of 9
      and a minimum reach of ∣5 −4 ∣= 1. Therefore, all reachable end-effector positions
         lie within an annular region satisfying 1 ≤𝑅≤9.
